Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
Cognizant Romania is home to 2300+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 About the role 
 We are looking for an experienced Angular Frontend Engineer to join an Agile delivery team and contribute to the development of complex, high-quality web solutions.
 In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain modern frontend applications using Angular and TypeScript. You will work closely with engineers, QA specialists, UX professionals, and other stakeholders to deliver clean, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
 You will also contribute to technical design decisions, code reviews, quality assurance, delivery automation, and the continuous improvement of engineering standards and team practices.
 For this position, you should be able to check the following: 
Demonstrable professional experience in software development
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, including performance optimization techniques
Hands-on experience with ES7+, TypeScript, and Angular 18+
Experience with UI and UX libraries or frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap
Advanced knowledge of frontend testing using Karma and Jasmine or Jest
Ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code aligned with industry best practices
Experience conducting thorough code reviews
Good understanding of software quality, maintainability, and QA automation processes
Ability to investigate and debug issues across complex system environments
Experience working independently and as part of Agile delivery teams
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Ability to design solutions using common design patterns and appropriate design tools
Ability to deliver complex, end-to-end solutions with limited supervision
Excellent English communication skills
 Nice to have: 
Experience with React
Experience with GitHub workflows
Knowledge of UX design principles
Experience working with Figma
Interest in delivery automation and continuous improvement
Understanding of security, risk, and control considerations in engineering solutions
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Work model: Hybrid, 3 days per week from the office, in Pipera
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
